hypotheses.name: Selected-At-Random (SAR) Geomorphically De-Biased Cross-Spectral Potential-Field Admittance & Geothermal Upflow Conduit PU (CSGD)

layers.role: circular volcanic plug non-fault mimic veto
Pleistocene Lake Lahontan <=1338 m shoreline censoring propensity

hypotheses.physical_signature: Combines (1) multi-scale band-limited cross-spectral gravity-magnetic admittance residuals |grad(Delta g_iso - H_GM * Delta RTP)| and hydrothermal magnetite-destruction troughs (curl-vetoed Laplace g_zz zero-crossing step where 150 m upward-continued TMI_up150 gradient is attenuated), (2) active convective geothermal upflow plumes from INGENIOUS GDR-1391 measured well/spring temperatures (temp_c > 25 C) and silica/cation reservoir geothermometers (geothermquartz_c, geothermchalc_c, geothermcat_c > 90 C) coupled with GeoDAWN K/Th & U/Th metasomatism steps, smectite conductance (B17), and transtensional strain/microseismicity (B4, B7, B8, B10, B16), and (3) Bekker-Davis Selected-At-Random (SAR) geomorphic censoring odds ((1 - e_hat(X_vis)) / (e_hat(X_vis) + tau))^gamma that divide out steep range-front scarp exposure propensity before 300 m expected-kernel-credit Poisson-disc dot placement.
hypotheses.catalogue_missing_rationale: Roughly 75% of Great Basin hydrothermal systems are blind (Faulds et al., 2015, 2021): Holocene alluvial-fan aggradation, pediment sheetwash, and Lake Lahontan (<=1338 m) lacustrine reworking bury surface fault scarps (low exposure propensity e_hat(X_vis)), whereas standard unweighted PU models (e.g., H86F-EWCS, H86C-KSLB) learn P(S=1|X) = P(Y=1|X)*e(X_vis) and crowd exposed bedrock range fronts (slope >= 6 deg, where mapped faults and 94.8% of GEMSDOE3's 3-px halo already sit). De-biasing by SAR censoring odds redirects emission onto buried piedmont, stepover, and intrabasin geothermal conduits whose basement density/admittance steps and thermal/argillic plumes survive surficial burial.
hypotheses.novelty_vs_repo_and_fleet: First lane in GEMSDOE86 to (a) implement windowed multi-scale gravity-magnetic cross-spectral admittance residuals + upward-continued TMI_up150 depth-attenuation decoupling, (b) couple label-free GDR-1391 silica/cation geothermometer and measured thermal well/spring plumes with volcanic-vent vetoing, (c) factorize PU fault learning under Bekker-Davis SAR geomorphic censoring propensity e_hat(X_vis) so DEM/slope is excluded from the deep fault classifier P_deep, and (d) rank placement by exact 300 m triangular DTI expected kernel credit.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Unfaulted Mesozoic pluton-wallrock roof contacts, closed-basin evaporite playa brines with lateral thermal outflow plumes, and Quaternary volcanic vents/plugs (mitigated via curl-vetoed Laplace g_zz, volcanic-vent proximity veto, and transtensional strain/admittance gating).
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Medium (vectorized multi-scale Gaussian cross-spectral operators + nested cross-component HGB + SAR propensity calibration; ~4 min CPU total for 3 arms).

hypotheses.name: Upward-Continued Magnetic Wavenumber Attenuation Ratio (RTP vs TMI_up150) & Euler Structural-Index Depth Staircase
hypotheses.physical_signature: Closed-form vertical harmonic decay ratio k_z = (1 / 150 m) * ln(||grad TMI|| / ||grad TMI_up150||) combined with Thompson-Reid Euler deconvolution (structural index N=0.5 fault step) to isolate abrupt cross-strike jumps in magnetic basement depth beneath non-magnetic Cenozoic fill.
hypotheses.catalogue_missing_rationale: Intrabasin synthetic and antithetic horst-bounding faults buried under 100-800 m of Quaternary playal/alluvial fill produce zero topographic relief but step the depth to Tertiary volcanic / Mesozoic crystalline magnetic basement.
hypotheses.novelty_vs_repo_and_fleet: Uses true physical upward-continued TMI_up150 wavenumber attenuation rather than single-level Verduzco tilt (H86F-EWCS, H86H-PSTD) or multi-scale Gaussian smoothing.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Shallow basaltic talus aprons, paleochannel maghemite lag gravels, and reversely magnetized Miocene ash-flow cooling-unit margins.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Low (pure closed-form potential-field harmonic decay; deferred to preserve strict single-lane / 3-experiment cap).

hypotheses.name: 10 m 3DEP Stream-Power Steepness (k_sn) Transient Knickzone Alignment & Sub-Pixel 1 m LiDAR Scarp Projection
hypotheses.physical_signature: Strike-aligned lateral bands of elevated normalized channel steepness k_sn (theta_ref = 0.45) across adjacent footwall-to-piedmont catchments projected down-drainage onto the basement-hinge inflection (grad B15), corroborated where 1 m LiDAR valid==1 by sub-pixel scarp coherence.
hypotheses.catalogue_missing_rationale: Active normal slip on range-front/piedmont faults generates upstream-migrating fluvial knickzones that persist for 10^5-10^6 yr even when rapid fan-head debris-flow deposition erases the surface scarp at the canyon mouth.
hypotheses.novelty_vs_repo_and_fleet: First explicit fluvial stream-power chi/k_sn transient knickzone projection hypothesis in GEMSDOE86; prior lanes used local 100 m DEM curvature/slope rather than drainage-area-normalized fluvial steepness.
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Resistant Paleozoic quartzite or welded silicic ignimbrite lithologic ledges (partially separable via GeoDAWN Th/K contrast) and heterogeneous 3DEP 1 m LiDAR tile boundaries.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: Medium (cross-catchment strike-projection + LiDAR coverage normalization; deferred to preserve single-lane cap).

hypotheses.name: EarthScope USArray 3D Crustal Magnetotelluric Phase-Tensor Skew (beta > 3 deg) & Subvertical Brittle-Ductile Conductor Ramps

layers.source: External IRIS/EarthScope EMTF SPUD Great Basin 3D MT Impedance Tensor Models (Bedrosian et al. / Wannamaker et al.; http://ds.iris.edu/spud/emtf)

hypotheses.physical_signature: Co-location of 3D magnetotelluric phase-tensor skew |beta| > 3 deg and subvertical mid-crustal low-resistivity ramps (3-15 km depth, 3-20 ohm-m) rooting directly beneath shallow smectite clay-cap conductance (Band 17) in dilational stepovers.
hypotheses.catalogue_missing_rationale: Resolves the #1 false-positive mimic in blind Basin-and-Range geothermal exploration by distinguishing flat-lying closed-basin evaporite playas (zero deep MT phase-tensor skew) from deep fault-hosted hydrothermal upflow plumes.
hypotheses.novelty_vs_repo_and_fleet: Introduces depth-resolved 3D crustal MT impedance phase tensors rather than the single surficial conductance grid (Band 17).
hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Pre-Cenozoic graphitic/sulfidic Roberts Mountains allochthon thrust black shales.
hypotheses.implementation_cost: High (3D MT tensor interpolation & galvanic distortion removal).
hypotheses.official_data_obtainability: NOT_VIABLE_IN_SANDBOX_YET: Official free public archive is EarthScope/IRIS SPUD EMTF (http://ds.iris.edu/spud/emtf) and USGS ScienceBase MT releases, which are outside the sandbox outbound host allowlist (github.com, codeload.github.com, api.github.com, registry.npmjs.org, pypi.org, files.pythonhosted.org) and have no cached bytes in .cache/external/.
